verdict.rationale: Docs show agents operating autonomously across editor/terminal/browser (antigravity-docs-7), producing rich Artifacts including implementation plans, code diffs, and browser recordings for review (antigravity-docs-24, antigravity-docs-30), with explicit human approval gates (antigravity-docs-25) and subagents for running tests (antigravity-docs-18) — directly supporting build/test/demo-for-review. However, community hands-on reports describe a subpar harness, slow/unreliable models, and app-breaking bugs (antigravity-comm-8, antigravity-comm-6), plus serious safety incidents (unquoted deletion command wiping a drive, data exfiltration via prompt injection) that undercut confidence in unattended end-to-end execution. Missing for 10: independent verification of a full build-test-demo cycle working smoothly, and resolution of the reliability/safety issues raised by users.
